title: A one-step binomial call
caption: From £100 the stock moves to £120 (call pays £20) or £80 (pays £0). With r = 0 the risk-neutral probability is q = 0.5, so the call is worth 0.5 × 20 + 0.5 × 0 = £10.
alt: A tree from £100 with an up branch to £120 and a down branch to £80, each of probability ½, and the call payoffs 20 and 0.
description: Up: stock £120, call pays £20. Down: stock £80, call pays £0.
